caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a purse, positioned centrally against a plain background within a bordered rectangle. The purse has a soft, slouchy appearance and is rendered in a dark brown color. It features a decorative floral embroidery in the center, comprised of various colors: red, pink, cream, blue, green, and yellow. The floral design is symmetrical and consists of motifs resembling roses and other assorted flowers surrounded by green leaves. The purse has a slightly glossy finish, indicating a possible leather or satin material. The edges of the purse are slightly wrinkled, and the top part appears slightly open or folded. The pencil-written annotation at the bottom right describes the object as "LADY'S PURSE," and additional text at the bottom left reads "R. MORTON DCL-380.1."
title: Purse
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
